verdict.rationale: Base44 explicitly supports GitHub sync for local development in your own editor with two-way sync back to the platform, a CLI for creating/syncing/deploying projects from the terminal, and an eject/clone command to pull code into a standalone local project; it also allows bringing your own agent/scripts via sandbox connection. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the GitHub sync workflow and any friction points reported by real developers using local tooling.
